citations.assessment: Naḥum asks Yoḥanan about a lamp kindled for a purpose other than food preparation; Yoḥanan says neither to forbid nor to permit.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

notes.text: The Yerushalmi gives the brother relationship explicitly. Beitzah in the heading is the tractate echoed in the formal locator.
